item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines. You can protect VMs with a Recovery Services vault in a different Azure subscription, as long as it is in the same tenant.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust is now generally available, providing a native Rust client for Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL. It supports direct database operations from Rust with built-in performance optimizations and failure handling.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: DocumentDB extension for VS Code
item.description:
DocumentDB for VS Code is now generally available. The free, open-source extension lets you connect Azure DocumentDB and the open-source DocumentDB project in Visual Studio Code for MongoDB API-compatible workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Fuzzy string match is available across Microsoft SQL offerings
item.description:
Fuzzy string match is now generally available across Microsoft SQL offerings, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL database in Microsoft Fabric, and SQL Server 2025. It lets you compare strings based on similarity or difference.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Open source license compliance generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud now generally available for open source license compliance, with ruleset-based checks to enforce centralized licensing policy across dependencies.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Formatter
item.description:
SQL Formatter is now generally available for Visual Studio Code, allowing SQL scripts to be formatted directly in the editor. It includes customizable formatting options to match preferred code styles.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Instant Access for VM restore points
item.description:
Instant Access for application-consistent restore points on Azure virtual machines is now generally available. It lets you start restoring a disk from a restore point before the underlying snapshot copy completes, for VMs using Premium SSD v2 or Ultra disks as data disks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot budget increase requests are generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports a request flow for users who have exhausted their AI credits, allowing them to ask for a budget increase instead of being fully blocked from credit-consuming features. The feature is now generally available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Global model policy generally available
item.description:
GitHub is gradually rolling out enforcement of a default global model policy for generally available GitHub Copilot models on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans. The policy was announced in July and is now generally available.

  • Source: GitHub
